## Why visit

An ideal place to explore Manchester cask in an informal pub setting. Blackjack’s own beers share space with guests, and the pub adds bar billiards, darts and comfortable seating rather than turning the visit into a standing-only tap list exercise. The real-cider bottle selection gives both travellers a second avenue to investigate. This is an especially useful stop between Marble Arch and Crown & Kettle: the three offer markedly different rooms and beer personalities while keeping the walking modest.

## Beer

Six handpumps are documented, usually with a substantial Blackjack contingent and guest cask. Irk Street Pale is listed as regular; all specific beers remain subject to change.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly identifies real cider in bottles, including Ross-on-Wye, and occasional handpump cider. Ask for the current bottles as well as the bar list.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Plan the visit

Card only according to CAMRA. Weekday opening can be later than lunchtime, especially Monday.

**Getting there:** Walk from Shudehill or Manchester Victoria; close to Crown & Kettle and Bar Fringe.
